distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the causal clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: The referral came from the walk-in centre, not my regular primary-care physician.
clue_answer: the referral came from a walk-in centre
clue_ablation_text: I am not sure; I do not have the referral-source detail available.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, I am trying to book the specialist appointment I was referred for.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can look at that. Do you have the referral date?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it was issued on the ninth.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Authorization is granted only when the referral comes from the required primary-care source; another source is declined.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Understood; I checked who issued the referral.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Are you currently taking any regular medication?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just a vitamin supplement.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have a preferred practitioner at the practice?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, whoever is available is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you travel to the second site if it were sooner?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I could manage that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the phone number ending in three-four-zero correct?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that one is right.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do mornings or afternoons suit you better?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mornings are easier for me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you need step-free access at the building?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, stairs are fine for me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like a reminder message beforehand?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, a message would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the address on the file still where you live?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, nothing has moved.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you seen this specialist before?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, this would be the first visit.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Did the referral come from the source required for authorization?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The referral came from the walk-in centre, not my regular primary-care physician.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Send the booking through for coverage approval.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will hold on while that happens.

authorization_status.not_requested: coverage authorization has not been requested
authorization_status.pending: the authorization request is awaiting a decision

causal_alignment.misaligned: the referral came from a source that does not qualify
causal_alignment.aligned: the referral came from the required qualifying source

pre_gap_actions.description: Send the booking through for coverage approval.
Reserve the slot and settle the coverage question later.
Move straight to a self-funded booking instead.
Ring the specialist office before requesting anything.
Close the request and ask the user to try again later.

post_gap_actions.description: Obtain the qualifying document from the provider type the policy requires.
Put the identical booking through for approval again now.
Ring the specialist office about the booking.
Leave the request in place and wait another interval.
Close the request because the review interval has passed.

causal_post_gap_observation.text: Thirty minutes have passed and the authorization review finished, but the decision is not displayed. Based on the referral detail I gave earlier, what should we do next?

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's frustration or experienced impact before proceeding.
Acknowledge the time pressure and prioritize the immediate next step.
Briefly clarify the situation and reassure the user before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

questions.question: Did the referral come from the source required for authorization?
questions.gold_answer: the referral came from a walk-in centre

questions.question: What time of day does the user prefer?
What did the coverage review decide?

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
